column1: COMPETITIVE POSITIONING - How Apollo differs from key competitors

column2: NOA owns its own generation assets and has AIIM/R3.9bn equity. Apollo differentiator: pure-play, no asset bias — Apollo will always find the best IPP for the customer, not its own. NOA's scale is a threat; Apollo's independence is the counter.
Enpower pioneered municipal wheeling and short-tenure PPAs. Apollo opportunity: adopt the 5-year PPA model and compete on flexibility + Reunert financial credibility.

Ampli's month-to-month model targets SMEs Apollo doesn't serve. Apollo opportunity: mid-market (500kW–5MW) is between Ampli's SME focus and Apollo's large C&I. Apollo should build a standardised product for this tier before others do.
EXSA is Remgro/RMB backed — institutional peer. Apollo differentiator: wind-first strategy vs EXSA's solar-first portfolio. Apollo's blended supply model is technically superior for 24/7 customers.

Apollo Africa is not just a licensed trader, it is a pure-play trader backed by the institutional strength of a JSE-listed group with 135 years of South African roots. No IPP parent. No asset agenda. Just the best energy solution for your business.
